evidence.detail: Reactified achievement detail page — resolves the blocker bakert cited in the issue comment
Classes cover LeaguePlayer, PerfectRun, FlawlessRun etc. but no LeagueTop8 or LeagueWinner class exists
preaggregate_achievements() rebuilds _achievements dynamically from all Achievement subclasses — adding new achievements does not require a traditional schema migration
Empty — confirming no such achievement exists

triage.notes: The reactification blocker is resolved, but 'league top 8' and 'league winner' map to monthly leaderboard positions, not d.finish on individual runs (unlike tournament achievements). The correct SQL needs clarification on how leaderboard rank is persisted. Also needs product judgment on what constitutes a 'league winner' each season.
